convention_notes.T_wc_vs_T_cw: adapter should normalize raw dataset poses into T_w_c first, then derive R_BA and t_BA_B using the same relative_pose_A_to_B_in_B convention already used in this repo
convention_notes.quaternion_order: store explicit adapter field for dataset quaternion order and convert to repo standard before pair generation
convention_notes.tdir_frame: B frame, matching current external evaluator assumptions
convention_notes.scale_unit: meters if provided; otherwise document pseudo-GT scale source
convention_notes.timestamp_alignment: for 360DVO use native 10 FPS frame index / timestamps; for datasets without timestamps synthesize monotonically increasing timestamps but mark them as synthetic
convention_notes.erp_resolution_resize_policy: keep native ERP metadata, then resize to current pipeline resolution in adapter config, not by overwriting raw files
convention_notes.train_eval_split_design: split by sequence id, not by random adjacent pairs, to avoid another DATA2-style motion leakage
convention_notes.tum_export: adapter should emit TUM-compatible absolute trajectory so current external evaluator can be reused
